class Window_MainWindow { constructor() { this.name = "MainWindow"; this.title = "Quick Kinetic Dashboard"; this.width = 1024; this.height = 768; } create() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Initialized context surface'); } start() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Started event loop'); } show() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Shown'); } hide() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Hidden'); } close() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Closed'); } destroy() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Destroyed resources'); } setTitle(newTitle) { this.title = newTitle; console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Title: ' + newTitle); } getTitle() { return this.title; } setSize(w, h) { this.width = w; this.height = h; console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Size: ' + w + 'x' + h); } getSize() { return [this.width, this.height]; } setPosition(x, y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Position: (' + x + ', ' + y + ')'); } getPosition() { return [this.x || 0, this.y || 0]; } center() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Centered on screen'); } maximize() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Maximized'); } minimize() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Minimized to taskbar'); } restore() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Restored'); } setFullscreen(flag) { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Fullscreen: ' + flag); } setResizable(flag) { this.resizable = flag; console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Resizable: ' + flag); } setAlwaysOnTop(flag) { this.alwaysOnTop = flag; console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] AlwaysOnTop: ' + flag); } setOpacity(val) { this.opacity = val; console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Opacity: ' + val); } setBackgroundColor(col) { this.backgroundColor = col; console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Background: ' + col); } onClose(cb) { this._onClose = cb; } onResize(cb) { this._onResize = cb; } onFocus(cb) { this._onFocus = cb; } function onSetup() { console.log("Window custom onSetup() executed"); } }; const MainWindow = new Window_MainWindow(); function runApplication() { let win = MainWindow; win.create(); win.setTitle("Kinetic App Pro v1.0"); win.setSize(1280, 720); win.setPosition(50, 50); win.center(); win.setAlwaysOnTop(true); win.setResizable(true); win.setOpacity(0.95); win.setBackgroundColor("#0f172a"); win.maximize(); win.restore(); win.start(); }
